scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: ounc elbow macaroni, carrot, onion, bell pepper, celery, mayonnaise, condensed milk, white sugar, white vinegar, salt pepper.
Step 1 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Gather all ingredients..

Step 2 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Rinse under cold water; drain and set aside..

Step 3 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Stir together carrots, red onion, bell peppers, and celery in a large serving bowl. Mix in mayonnaise, condensed milk, sugar, vinegar, salt, and pepper until well combined..
Step 4 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Add macaroni; toss gently, then cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours..
Step 5 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Enjoy!.
